verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a client/server UI framework library, not a hosted service that holds a user's data. Exporting all of one's data in open formats and leaving is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows SolidJS storing user data or offering an export capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
